transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Um, well, I came in because... I don't know, for a long time now I've just been walking around with this flat, heavy feeling. Like, even when work is going okay or people are nice to me, I still just feel down and kind of empty most days.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Um, I'd say it's been going on for about two years and two months now. It pretty much started right around the time this dashboard project put me in the spotlight at work.
During these past two years, have there been any periods of two months or longer where you felt like your normal self or were completely free of these low moods?

Um, no, not really. I don't think I've had a break that long. I mean, maybe a day or two here and there where I feel a little better, but... yeah, definitely not two whole months. It's just been pretty constant since it started.
During these past two years, have you noticed any changes in your appetite, such as eating significantly more or less than you usually do?
Um, no, I haven't really noticed any big changes with my appetite. I eat about the same amount as I always have.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns, such as having trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or sleeping too much, over the last two years?
No, my sleep has been pretty normal, actually. I don't really have any trouble falling asleep, and I'm not sleeping way more than usual or anything. It's just been about the same as it always is.
How would you describe your self-esteem or how you feel about yourself during these past two years?

Um, pretty low, honestly. I don't feel great about myself. Like, at work, people will still bring up this dashboard I built, and my first thought is always that I somehow fooled them. And then if I miss a follow-up or send an email late, it just... it feels like proof that I'm not actually as capable as they think I am.
Do you often feel a sense of hopelessness about the future?

Yeah, I do. Um, I used to map out my MBA plans and all my career steps in a lot of detail. But lately, I look at those same plans and just... I just assume I'm not going to get there, no matter how much I try.
Do you often feel physically tired or as though you have low energy throughout the day?

Yeah, I do. By the afternoon, I'm usually just... completely wiped out. It gets to the point where doing even the basic stuff at work, like fixing a spreadsheet error or finishing up some expense paperwork, takes so much effort. And trying to get myself to soccer later... it honestly feels like I'm just dragging my body and my brain through mud.
Do you find that you have trouble concentrating on your tasks or making decisions throughout the day?

Um, I'm not really sure. I haven't really noticed a problem with concentrating or making decisions, honestly. I just feel tired and like I'm not going to get anywhere, but I can still focus on things when I have to.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt unusually high, energetic, or irritable, to the point where you were getting very little sleep and felt like you could do anything?

No, I can't say I've ever felt like that. I mean, I've had good days where I got a lot done, but nothing extreme like feeling unusually high or not needing sleep. It's usually the opposite for me, honestly.
